title: Standing Note on Vehicles Never Collected
content:
A renter who does not collect the vehicle within the supplier's holding time after the scheduled collection
is recorded as a no-show and the rate class's no-show charge is withheld. Across the Car Rental Rate Classes
the supplier's holding time is 2 hours after the scheduled collection moment.

## What a no-show does to the rest of the rental

A no-show releases the whole rental, and the remaining days are cancelled with no further charge.

A no-show charge and a cancellation charge are never both withheld on the same rental: whichever applies
replaces the other.

## Where the supplier had no vehicle

No charge is withheld where the renter could not collect because the supplier had no vehicle, and the
supplier notice terms apply instead.

## Settling the charge against money already held

Where the prepayment already held is smaller than the charge, the balance is taken from the card on file,
and where it is larger the difference is returned.

## The renter who arrives late

A renter who arrives after the holding time has passed is treated as a fresh walk-up at the counter and not
as the holder of this rental.

| Hours after the scheduled collection at which the renter arrives | Within the supplier's holding time of 2 hours | Standing on this rental |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | yes | still the holder of the rental |
| 2 | yes | still the holder of the rental |
| 3 | no | a fresh walk-up at the counter |
